svg.title: From formula text to a Filament outcome
svg.desc: A formula moves from text to a Filament outcome. tl-parse turns MLTL text into a formula document, tl-rewrite returns a rewritten document, and tl-mltl evaluates it against a trace. In tests, tl-oracle evaluates the same formula and trace independently and the verdicts are compared. filament-mltl maps the result to a Boolean Value or a typed NonValue reason. All documents use the vocabulary of tl-syntax.

g.data-text: Profile tl-family version 1Time domain: discrete stepsDocuments use the vocabulary of tl-syntax.View pipeline-view: positions 0 to 6 of 7.
Value or NonValue: true / false or reason
MLTL text to tl-parse: [sync] MLTL text
tl-mltl to tl-oracle (this crate): [async] formula + trace (tests only)
tl-oracle (this crate) to tl-mltl: [return] reference verdict (replies to m3)
